about.en: Tesla (Ondo Tokenized) (TSLAon) is an Ondo tokenized stock issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited through the Ondo Stocks platform, giving eligible non-US holders economic exposure to Tesla, Inc. shares (TSLA). It is fully backed by the underlying security and is a total return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xf6b1117ec07684d3958cad8beb1b302bfd21103f, with deployments on BNB Chain and Solana. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights.
